evidence: Pinned inputs and an executable synthetic generator; no benchmark has been run.

real.pin_evidence: Prime verified both object IDs using git ls-remote before this reference asset was authored.
real.capture: Use normal public-HTTPS intake with the pinned revision; capture the entire tree under the ordinary source-intake policy. No benchmark path subset or additional exclusion.
real.failure_policy: The tree includes intentionally invalid test sources. Preserve terminal failures and blocked downstream work; do not delete those files, weaken parsing or claim index_complete. Record the actual census and outcomes.

synthetic.selection: Include a fixture only when every expected extraction file has status SUCCEEDED; include every source file of that fixture, including empty files.
synthetic.source_bytes: Encode each source string as UTF-8 exactly; no newline normalization, rewriting, wrappers or generated code.
synthetic.census_hash: SHA-256 of the full files array sorted by path, serialized as UTF-8 JSON with sort_keys=true, ensure_ascii=false, allow_nan=false and separators=(',', ':'); no trailing newline. Each row contains path, fixture_id, source_path, language, bytes and the SHA-256 of original file bytes. Repeated content remains a separate path entry.
synthetic.purpose: Volume and accounting only; not real-world representativeness. Assess each fixture's semantic expectations individually with its own profile. Replication does not make those profiles interchangeable or prove the combined corpus succeeds.

protocol.effective_scanner_slots: Set validated workers.scanner_slots=min(2, workers.heavy_slots), including 1 for the serial run; the cap is not an implicit settings clamp. Scanner and compiler work consume the same total heavy-slot budget.
protocol.fresh_storage: New disposable PostgreSQL database and managed Git storage for every repetition; no extraction, resolution or flagging dataset reuse. Record OS/tool-cache conditions separately.
freeze: source commit/tree or synthetic full census digest
application commit, dependency lock and installed tool/resource digests
compiler/library/resource digests and explicit build-context limitations
scanner executable version/digest and exact rule manifest/mode/digest
resolved semantic settings and extraction/resolution/flagging profile digests
protocol.compare: Compare full normalized success records, source/work census, terminal failure classifications, blocked work and completeness state against the serial baseline. Retain semantic diagnostics; remove only documented run-local IDs, timestamps, transient attempt data and worker/runtime diagnostics. Rebind IDs to stable physical locators before comparison.
protocol.warm_reuse: Run and report separately with cache/reused dataset identities and reused work counts; never mix warm reuse into fresh-storage timings.
